two_inert_controls_i_found_in_my_own_tea: 1. `--still-fire-a-field` first called `censusBegin({})` alone. The row stayed green, arm for arm identical to the untorn run, because the opening STARTS PAUSED at `hold.come-to` and `censusBegin` emits `dialogue_open` only on an unpaused node. Both arms were the positive arm — rule 6's inert control, the shape W1-04's wall-collision control had.

2. Fixed to drive to `hold.hatch-name` and answer it, the sabotage demonstrably wrote a field (`node_before_answer: hold.hatch-name` -> `node_after_answer: hold.out`) and the row STILL stayed green: `creation_field` never reached the trace at that frame. `sim/events.js EventBus` is a per-frame pool cleared each step, so an event emitted BETWEEN stepped frames can be cleared before any record snapshots it. A trace-only row would have shipped a control it had never seen go red. `m4StillClause1` now reads the running world as well (`asked_while_still`), which is what makes ARM B red.
